method: Hierarchical composition with each distinct logic module synthesized independently against exact child-port stubs; no flattening and no DFF enable/reset merging. Area and resource sums include every reachable instance with multiplicity, exclude ROM-service interiors, and do not include cross-boundary optimization.

partition.deduplication: Exact normalized RTLIL comparison by SHA256, removing only src/hdlname/top attributes, replacing module identity and recursively identical child type names. Black-box identities are never merged. All other identifiers, constants, parameters and attributes retained.

capacity.scope: Logical memory capacity; not a mapped BRAM result, bandwidth/port layout, quality result, or ASIC area.
caveats: 28.6MB includes mixed formats and metadata, not all UINT8 weights.
K64 comparison retains 8-bit representatives; it does not require 4-bit activations.
Frontend uses original affine INT8 reconstruction, not a four-bit quantizer.
Small LUTs, duplication for extra read ports, banking fragmentation, writable state and periphery must be added.
The v2 RTL is synthesized here; W11 v4 compressed implementation has separate qualification.
BRAM36 capacity includes parity bits; using only 32k data bits requires more blocks.
Existing logical storage inventory is v1; v2 changes constants only per retained qualification.
Rectangular BRAM estimate chooses one 36K primitive mode per array, assumes one read port and usable parity bits; it does not implement clock/latency translation or verify a device placement.
capacity.inventory_correction: Earlier inventory case detector omitted the 1072-row, 64-bit paired cosine/sine rotary table. W12 isolates it and adds 68,608 bits. Read-port replication still excluded.

records.orchestration_error: archive moved .ys because suffix comparison omitted dot; files restored byte-for-byte from retained archive before restart

limitations: Per-module tool results are a compositional synthesizability result, not a successful monolithic synth command, equivalence test, timing closure, placement or routing.
ECP5 primitive sums are not Xilinx resource estimates.
ROM service handshakes/control inside the existing black boxes remain excluded.
Only fully passing unit sets have complete totals; partial sums are explicitly labeled.
Guard termination and tool crashes are resource/tool failures, not identified unsupported RTL constructs.
